source: Create a minigolf game that can be played across devices. The game should allow players to create and discover lobbies, lobbies should have settings like enabling collision between player balls. The controls are basically being able to aim left and right and then hold and release for power of shot. While the ball can move in any direction, the shot will only move the ball on the golf course itself. Create 15 courses, have par scores for each course and track the score for each player through leaderboard.

image_prompt.text: The hole at the end of each course, built as a target that registers the ball dropping in
Painted markings along each course showing distance from the tee
The tee position each hole is started from, with room for a player to line up a shot
The edge of the putting surface, built so a script can catch a ball leaving the course and reset it

layout_placement.text: Cup detection at each hole, registering the score for the player whose ball entered
Static tee positions the ball resets to at the start of each hole
A detection perimeter around the playable surface, since shots are only allowed to move the ball on the course itself

notes: Fifteen courses almost certainly means fifteen separate maps (P4), but the emit block carries one shape and no map count, so this is recorded here rather than routed.
Ball-to-ball collision is a per-lobby toggle, so the layout has to work both with and without it.

open_questions.ask: No look was given — should these be classic mini-golf windmills-and-astroturf, or something stylized?
Are the fifteen courses one connected park you walk between, or separate places you are teleported into?

coverage_missing.ask: Classic mini-golf dressing or something stylized?
Is each course one continuous hole, or several holes per course?
How long is a single course?

answers.ask: No look was given — should these be classic mini-golf windmills-and-astroturf, or something stylized?
answers.answer: Use a classic mini-golf look with astroturf lanes, simple colorful obstacles, and windmill-style course decoration.

answers.ask: Are the fifteen courses one connected park you walk between, or separate places you are teleported into?
answers.answer: Make the fifteen courses separate holes players are teleported into in sequence; this keeps the game compact and focused.
